g.text: Machine Learning Clinical Risk Engine & Explainable AI (SHAP)
Ensemble Gradient Boosting (LightGBM/XGBoost) • ROC-AUC 0.962 • Calibrated Probabilities • MLflow Registry
Clinical Cohort N=12,450 Patients • Test Set 20%
TreeSHAP exact algorithm • 24ms computation time • Lundberg & Lee 2017
• Non-diagnostic risk estimation intended for physician review
• Recommend confirmatory fasting plasma glucose & 24-hr ambulatory BP
• Lifestyle intervention (DASH Diet) could reduce 10-yr risk by −6.8%
STANDARDS: TRIPOD Statement (Transparent Reporting of a multivariable prediction model) • SHAP Unified Explainability • Platt Calibration
